title: Depth 10 -> 12 at constant width 512
description: DEPTH 10 -> 12 and ASPECT_RATIO 48 -> 40, so model_dim stays 512 with 4 heads of 128; pure depth change, nothing else touched.
reflection: POSITIVE: val_bpb 0.986675 vs baseline 0.989007, -0.0023 (about 2.5x the ~0.0009 noise floor). Numbers: params 60.8M -> 71.3M, FLOPs/token 2.96e8 -> 3.46e8 (+17%), total_tokens 381M -> 331M (-13%), num_steps 2526, steady-state MFU 38.43% (vs 37.8%, so the MFU gain from depth has saturated), peak VRAM 27.1 -> 32.1 GB. The depth axis still pays but with clearly diminishing returns: 8->10 bought -0.0082, 10->12 bought only -0.0023 for a similar relative FLOP cost, and the token budget is now shrinking faster than capacity helps. Extrapolating, 12->14 is likely near zero or negative; I would not spend a slot on it. The interesting reading is that we are approaching the compute-optimal shape at this 5-minute budget, so the next gains should come from something that is not pure capacity -- e.g. width (model_dim 512 -> 640 at depth 10-12) to test whether the model is now width-starved rather than depth-starved, or the untouched WINDOW_PATTERN / value-embedding structure. VRAM at 32.1 GB is still comfortable but a further depth+width increase should watch it.
